dataset.name: CelebA-Spoof
dataset.terms: Non-commercial research; no redistribution outside the permitted internal single-site organizational use. See the author's Dataset Agreement.
dataset.subset_policy: A documented smaller subset is permitted; preserve official subject membership and selected attack families, and report subset counts/results.

labels.score: p_spoof; larger means more likely spoof

splits.name: webcam_test
splits.assignment: new consenting local subjects; no training or selection
splits.use: held-out physical print, screen-photo and video-replay tests

split_rules.unknown_subject_or_membership: quarantine; never infer from row order
split_rules.missing_official_validation: stop; resolve release metadata before generating a manifest

webcam.conditions: Use people, devices and lighting outside training conditions; record actual conditions and any unverified independence.
webcam.test_design: Cover each presentation; no fixed counts, durations, sampling rates or full condition cross-product.
webcam.threshold_source: validation only; frozen before final dataset and webcam tests
webcam.report: correct/total per presentation; live rejection and attack failures with observed conditions

method.model: one RGB CNN; train from scratch or partially fine-tune
method.attendance_policy: block spoof and show warning; require live and verified identity to record attendance
method.policy_origin: attendance blocking is a project design choice; the brief requires integration and liveness display
method.scope: image classification; no motion analysis or multi-frame aggregation
